2893-3875-4826-8336.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

7084-7201-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a 3/4 green Treefolk creature token with reach
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5235-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.

5235-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Brokers Hideout.
When Brokers Hideout enters, it and Tifa trigger.
Resolve the Tifa trigger, doubling its power until end of turn.
Resolve the Brokers Hideout trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Clown Car.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Repeat from step 2.

Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

225-2092-4050-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Ba Sing Se.
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {G} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and tapping it, earthbending another land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the other earthbent land, adding {G}.
When the land dies, Ba Sing Se triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4681-5170-7452.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

240-2511-4359-5470.description:

Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

1921-4659-7220.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Glamermite from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Glamermite token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Glamermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-3755-4885-7075.description:

104-567-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-567-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.

Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat from step 3.

It is an opponent's turn.

If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.

The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3327-4549-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
3327-4549-5147.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1792-2364-5864.notablePrerequisites: You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1792-2364-5864.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Retraction Helix.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2511-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

549-3259-4068-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
549-3259-4068-5953.notablePrerequisites:

An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-4068-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.

2211-3670-4508.description:

Repeat from step 3.

1164-2056-2631-4243.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli has at least three loyalty counters.
{1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Alrund's Epiphany was foretold.
1164-2056-2631-4243.description:
Cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Alrund's Epiphany, causing you to create two 1/1 Bird creature tokens, take an extra turn after this one and exile Alrund's Epiphany.

Activate the Servo by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Alrund's Epiphany and up to six other cards face up in exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, with Alrund's Epiphany being the topmost card.
If Saheeli has fewer than three loyalty counters on it, activate Venser's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, exiling Saheeli until your next end step.
At the beginning of your end step, if you activated Venser's ability, Venser triggers, returning Saheeli from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn, drawing Alrund's Epiphany during your draw step.

569-3519-4115.notablePrerequisites: You do not control another Bird or have a Bird in your graveyard.
569-3519-4115.description:

Volo triggers, creating a copy of the Mist Raven spell.
The Mist Raven copy enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Mist Raven token, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Mist Raven enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

2174-3478-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-3478-4222.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
